title: There is no god but Allah alone, a hundred times
cue: Said a hundred times in a day
arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
transliteration: Laa ilaha illallaahu wahdahu laa shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
translation: There is no god but Allah alone, without partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He has power over all things.

witnesses.name: shamela
witnesses.ref: Sahih al-Bukhari, al-Sultaniyya print, hadith 6403: https://shamela.ws/book/1681/9610

usage.evidence: Whoever says it a hundred times in a day, it is for him like freeing ten slaves, a hundred good deeds are written for him and a hundred bad deeds wiped away, and it is a protection for him from Satan that day until evening (al-Bukhari 6403; Muslim 2691).
